retained_source_profiles_role: Prior literature profiles remain source evidence; they are not the current three-model project proposal.
initial_proposal_snapshot_note: Original zero execution/file counts and null architecture_configuration below describe the documentary proposal operation, not the current project execution state. The current_execution object supersedes those counts for the development experiment.
formal_selected_families_meaning: Empty refers to closure of the guide literature-extraction requirement; the experimentally selected development trio is recorded in current_execution.
experimental_protocol_frozen_meaning: Original proposal flag; the subsequent development plan is frozen in current_execution.protocol_final, while the final held-out test protocol is not frozen.
